title: Flat-wall boundary layer: does a near-wall layer emerge?

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

geometry: 450 × 200 domain; diffuse plate on [100, 400] in a specular floor; open (reservoir) inlet, outlet and top
wallModel: segmented planar floor (Maxwell accommodation on the plate); reservoir inlet, outlet and far-field top (A-18)

reynolds.note: Re_sim = ρ_e U_e L_plate / μ at the plate end; Re_eff = ρ_e U_e δ* / μ from the layer's own measured displacement thickness at the last station. μ from results/viscosity_reference.json (base: φ=0.1, H=40, U=0.5, Aw=1, Couette μ_eff, 0.2.0-p0.2). Apparent wall viscosity τ_w/(∂u/∂y) measured here: 0.345 ± 0.019.

mach.note: Mp = U_e/c_p, c_p from results/sound-speed_sweeps.json (A φ=0.1, 0.2.0-p0.2) (measured at the stated, not the realised, density)

emptySpace.note: Master prompt §20: occupancy and density extremes on cells of ~40 particles; a cell below 0.1 φ_mean in 5 consecutive samples flags POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE. Low density near open boundaries (A-18) is expected and is not near-zero occupancy.

results.determination: EMERGED: a near-wall velocity deficit exists over the plate and its displacement thickness grows downstream

uncertainty.note: Ensemble over independent seeds (t-based CIs) for every station quantity.

convergence.note: Single resolution; domain height and plate length dependence not yet studied.

benchmarks.note: Blasius (incompressible continuum, no slip, Re → ∞): comparison only. At Re ~ 10² and with wall slip it is not expected to hold.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor
Energy ledger incl. wall heat and open-boundary fluxes closes
Momentum ledger incl. wall and open-boundary fluxes closes

acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag

acceptance.description: Plate-averaged wall shear is the same in both halves of the measurement
No near-wall velocity deficit over the specular floor upstream of the plate (control)

warnings: Realised free-stream density 0.115 differs from the reservoir's stated 0.127 by -9.7 % (A-18). All normalisations use the realised value.

viscosity.source: results/viscosity_reference.json (base: φ=0.1, H=40, U=0.5, Aw=1, Couette μ_eff, 0.2.0-p0.2)
